{"tools":[
{"name":"send_email","description":"Composes and sends a new email from the shop mailbox. Use for any fresh outgoing message that is not a reply to or forward of an existing one.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"to":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"minItems":1},"cc":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"email"}},"bcc":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"email"}},"subject":{"type":"string"},"body":{"type":"string","description":"Message body"},"body_format":{"type":"string","enum":["plain","html"],"default":"plain"},"attachment_paths":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["to","subject","body"]},"request":"Send an email to supplier@greenleafwholesale.example asking when the back-ordered ceramic planters will ship."},
{"name":"reply_to_email","description":"Sends a reply in the same thread to a specific received message. Use when answering a customer or supplier message so the conversation stays threaded.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"message_id":{"type":"string"},"body":{"type":"string"},"reply_all":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"body_format":{"type":"string","enum":["plain","html"],"default":"plain"}},"required":["message_id","body"]},"request":"Reply to message msg_88213 and tell them we can swap the size M for a size L at no charge."},
{"name":"forward_email","description":"Forwards an existing message, including its attachments, to one or more recipients with an optional note. Use to pass a message to a colleague, accountant or supplier.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"message_id":{"type":"string"},"to":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"minItems":1},"note":{"type":"string"},"include_attachments":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["message_id","to"]},"request":"Forward the invoice email msg_90412 to our bookkeeper at tom@harborbooks.example with a note saying it's for the March accounts."},
{"name":"create_draft","description":"Saves a new draft email without sending it. Use when the manager wants to review or edit a message before it goes out.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"to":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"email"}},"cc":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","format":"email"}},"subject":{"type":"string"},"body":{"type":"string"},"in_reply_to_message_id":{"type":"string","description":"Optional message to draft a reply to"}},"required":["subject","body"]},"request":"Draft an email to our newsletter list about the weekend sale, but don't send it yet, I want to look at it first."},
{"name":"send_draft","description":"Sends a previously saved draft by its ID. Use after the draft has been approved.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"draft_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["draft_id"]},"request":"The draft draft_4471 looks good now, go ahead and send it."},
{"name":"list_messages","description":"Lists messages in a mailbox folder or under a label, newest first, with sender, subject, date and read status. Use to browse the inbox or check what is unread.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"folder":{"type":"string","enum":["inbox","sent","drafts","archive","trash","spam"],"default":"inbox"},"label":{"type":"string"},"unread_only":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25},"page_token":{"type":"string"}},"required":[]},"request":"Show me the unread emails in the inbox from this morning."},
{"name":"get_email","description":"Retrieves the full content of a single message: headers, body, labels and attachment list. Use when the manager wants to read a specific email.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"message_id":{"type":"string"},"mark_as_read":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"format":{"type":"string","enum":["text","html"],"default":"text"}},"required":["message_id"]},"request":"Open message msg_77120 and read me what the customer wrote."},
{"name":"get_thread","description":"Returns every message in a conversation thread in chronological order. Use to catch up on the full back-and-forth before responding.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"thread_id":{"type":"string"},"max_messages":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"default":50}},"required":["thread_id"]},"request":"Pull up the whole conversation thread thr_5530 so I can see what we already promised the customer."},
{"name":"search_emails","description":"Searches the mailbox by free text with optional filters for sender, recipient, subject, date range, label and attachments. Use for general lookups when no specific customer or order is involved.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"},"from":{"type":"string"},"to":{"type":"string"},"subject":{"type":"string"},"label":{"type":"string"},"has_attachment":{"type":"boolean"},"after":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"before":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25}},"required":[]},"request":"Search the mailbox for emails with attachments mentioning 'wholesale price list' from last quarter."},
{"name":"find_customer_emails","description":"Finds all email correspondence to and from a particular customer email address, sent and received. Use to review the email history with one customer, not to look up their account record.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_email":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"direction":{"type":"string","enum":["sent","received","both"],"default":"both"},"after":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":25}},"required":["customer_email"]},"request":"What emails have we exchanged with maria.lopez@example.com?"},
{"name":"find_order_emails","description":"Finds emails that mention a given order number in the subject or body, such as customer enquiries and carrier notices. Use to see email messages related to an order, not the order's status.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"order_number":{"type":"string"},"include_sent":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["order_number"]},"request":"Find any emails in the mailbox that mention order #10482."},
{"name":"send_refund_notice","description":"Sends the standard refund-confirmation email to a customer with the amount and order number filled in. Use only to notify the customer by email; it does not issue the refund.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_email":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"order_number":{"type":"string"},"refund_amount":{"type":"number","minimum":0},"currency":{"type":"string","default":"USD"},"expected_days":{"type":"integer","default":5},"personal_note":{"type":"string"}},"required":["customer_email","order_number","refund_amount"]},"request":"Email jane.cho@example.com the refund confirmation for order 1187, $42.50, so she knows it's on its way."},
{"name":"download_attachment","description":"Saves an attachment from a received message to the local file store and returns its path. Use to obtain invoices, images or documents attached to an email.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"message_id":{"type":"string"},"attachment_id":{"type":"string"},"destination_dir":{"type":"string"}},"required":["message_id","attachment_id"]},"request":"Download the PDF attached to msg_90412 into the invoices folder."},
{"name":"list_labels","description":"Lists all labels in the mailbox with their IDs and message counts. Use to see which labels exist before applying one.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"include_system_labels":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":[]},"request":"What labels do we have set up in the mailbox right now?"},
{"name":"create_label","description":"Creates a new label, optionally with a color or nested under a parent label. Use when a new category of email is needed.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"parent_label":{"type":"string"},"color":{"type":"string","description":"Hex color such as #ff8800"}},"required":["name"]},"request":"Create a new label called 'Wholesale Enquiries' in orange."},
{"name":"add_label","description":"Applies one or more labels to one or more messages. Use to categorize emails such as complaints, supplier mail or returns.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"message_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":1},"labels":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":1}},"required":["message_ids","labels"]},"request":"Tag messages msg_88213 and msg_88290 with the 'Returns' label."},
{"name":"remove_label","description":"Removes one or more labels from one or more messages without deleting the messages. Use when a message was categorized wrongly or the issue is resolved.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"message_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":1},"labels":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":1}},"required":["message_ids","labels"]},"request":"Take the 'Urgent' label off msg_77120, that issue is sorted."},
{"name":"set_read_status","description":"Marks messages as read or unread. Use to clear notifications or to flag a message to come back to.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"message_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":1},"read":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["message_ids","read"]},"request":"Mark msg_66001 as unread so I remember to look at it again tomorrow."},
{"name":"archive_email","description":"Moves messages out of the inbox into the archive without deleting them. Use to tidy the inbox once an email has been handled.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"message_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"minItems":1}},"required":["message_ids"]},"request":"Archive the three emails about the delivered pallet, msg_55010, msg_55011 and msg_55014."},
{"name":"get_mailbox_report","description":"Produces a report on mailbox activity for a period: emails received and sent, average response time, unanswered messages and counts per label. Use to measure how well the inbox is being handled.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"group_by":{"type":"string","enum":["day","week","label","sender_domain"],"default":"week"},"include_response_times":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["start_date","end_date"]}, "request":"Give me a report of how many emails we received and our average reply time for last month."}
]}
